Usage:
  vela add plugin <Name> --entity <ModelType> [--message <Message>] [--stage <PreValidation|PreOperation|PostOperation>] [--mode <Sync|Async>] [--filtering-attributes <Col1,Col2>] [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  vela add service <Name> --entity <ModelType> [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  vela add customapi <Name> [--entity <ModelType>] [--bound|--global] [--function|--action] [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  vela add test <Name> [--kind plugin|customapi] [--entity <ModelType>] [--message <Message>] [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  vela add step <PluginName> --entity <ModelType> [--message <Message>] [--handler <Method>] [--stage <PreValidation|PreOperation|PostOperation>] [--mode <Sync|Async>] [--filtering-attributes <Col1,Col2>] [--project <csproj>]
  vela add form-script <entity> [--project <web-resources dir>] [--force]   (preview)
  vela add ribbon-script <entity> [--project <web-resources dir>] [--force] (preview, ribbon commands)
  vela add --interactive            # guided wizard

Generates a single file into an existing project, inferring namespaces from its RootNamespace.
A service scaffolds a table-scoped interface + implementation; omit --entity on a Custom API for a global (unbound) one.
Run 'vela add test' inside your test project (RootNamespace ending in .Tests); <Name> is the class under test.
'vela add step' edits an existing handler-based (multi-step) plugin, adding a step + handler method.

Usage:
  vela models --solution <uniquename> [connection options]
  vela models --entities account,contact [connection options]
  vela models --custom-apis zava_DoThing [connection options]
  vela models --custom-apis [connection options]   (no value: every Custom API in the environment)
  vela models --custom-apis --package bin/Zava.Plugins.nupkg [connection options]   (no value, minus your authored Custom APIs)
  vela models --messages QualifyLead,AddToQueue [connection options]
  vela models --messages [connection options]   (no value: all consumable messages, filtered)
  vela models --roles "Salesperson,Sales Manager" [connection options]
  vela models --forms --entities account,contact [connection options]   (preview)
  vela models --tables --entities account,contact [connection options]  (preview)
  vela models --forms --tables --entities account,contact [connection options]  (preview, both + one barrel)
  vela models --from-solution ./MySolution.zip --namespace Acme.Shared.Models   (offline, no connection)

Generates early-bound classes for the scoped tables/Custom APIs over your Dataverse connection.
  --from-solution <zip>     offline: generate C# entity models + option-set enums from an exported (unmanaged) solution zip, with no connection
  --solution <uniquename>   tables taken from the solution's components
  --entities <a,b,c>        explicit table logical names (combinable with --solution)
  --intersect               also generate the N:N join (intersect) tables of the scoped tables, so typed queries can target them (live only)
  --custom-apis <a,b,c>     Custom API unique names → typed Request/Response classes (into Messages/)
  --messages [a,b,c]        SDK message names → typed Request/Response classes into Messages/ (any sdkmessage; pairs with OnMessage<TRequest>())
                            with no value: generate ALL consumable messages, skipping internal/private, Custom-API-backed, and messages that already have an SDK request class
  --package <file.nupkg>    (optional, repeatable) built 
[truncated]

result.stdout:
vela logs            (alias: vela trace)
  Read a Dataverse environment's execution diagnostics (read-only).

  Default source: the Plug-in Trace Log (plugintracelog).
  --jobs           read failed system jobs (asyncoperation) instead - where an async step's
                   failure is recorded even when plug-in tracing is off (--all-statuses for every status)
  --errors         (trace log) only entries that carry an exception
  --top <n>        max entries, newest first (1-200, default 20)
  --since <when>   only entries since a duration (30m / 2h / 3d) or a date
  --type <name>    filter by plugin type name (substring); --message <m>, --entity <logical>, --correlation <guid>
  --full           do not truncate the trace/exception text
  --json           machine-readable output: { mode, count, logs: [...] }

  Connect with -i (interactive) or the --connection-string / client-secret flags.
  Examples:
    vela logs --errors --since 1h -i
    vela logs --jobs --since 1d --json
